That works nicely. I pasted the MDN link, hit **Save link**, and it went off and filled in the title and a short description on its own, then showed the link with its address right there in a clean card. That's exactly the effortless saving I was hoping for — I paste, and it does the busywork.

The one field with a **Save link** button feels right too, and seeing the title, description, and address at a glance is just what I want. Good direction.
